V01.drivers: Typical slim adult proportions, smooth chest-to-pelvis taper, normal leg/trunk ratio, plantigrade feet, straight stance

structure.axial_section_shape: oval chest tapering smoothly to slightly narrower pelvis
structure.joint_integration: smooth rounded shoulders, unremarkable elbow/knee/ankle transitions
structure.segment_relations: legs about half height, hands at mid-thigh, ordinary hand/foot size
structure.load_path: vertical through pelvis, straight legs to heel/forefoot

V02.drivers: Near-identical to V01; slightly broader shoulders, ordinary human taper and limb proportions

structure.axial_section_shape: slightly wider chest, gentle V-taper to pelvis

V03.drivers: Ordinary human with softer belly; profile shows mild abdominal and buttock fullness

structure.axial_section_shape: rounder trunk, less waist taper, deeper abdomen in profile

V04.drivers: Slim ordinary human, very similar to V01/V02

V05.drivers: Ordinary human; slight chest softness, slightly wider hips, normal proportions

structure.axial_section_shape: oval trunk, mild waist, slightly wider hips

V06.drivers: Ordinary slim human, essentially same morphology as V01/V04

V07.drivers: Ordinary human with broader shoulders and fuller belly/buttock in profile, like V03

structure.axial_section_shape: broad, deeper trunk with little waist taper

V08.drivers: Narrow sloped shoulders, deep keel-like ribcage that bulges high in profile over a pinched waist, very slender limbs with long forearms/hands, knees set slightly flexed with a posterior bulge, thin shins
axial_cues: high, deep ribcage bulge in profile (front and back)
limb_cues: long thin forearms and long fingers
knobby knee transition with slight flexion

structure.axial_section_shape: barrel/keel chest much deeper than a narrow waist and pelvis
structure.joint_integration: knobby, abrupt joint transitions; narrow sloping shoulder girdle; slightly flexed knee
structure.segment_relations: long arms and hands relative to trunk, slender long legs, small pelvis
structure.load_path: weight carried high in chest then down a narrow pelvis to slightly flexed, thin legs; forward-shifted

non_structural_factors.notes: thinness contributes but the chest/waist organization and joints drive the read

V09.drivers: Ordinary slim human, same family as V01/V04/V06

V10.drivers: Massive shoulder/trapezius mass with plate-like shoulders, very broad chest over narrower pelvis, short thick bent legs with huge knees and calves, large hands and wide splayed feet, forward-leaning profile with crouched knees, an extra appendage/fragment near the hip in profile (possible tail or prop)
limb_cues: bent knees with large knee masses

structure.axial_section_shape: inverted-trapezoid trunk: enormous shoulder/chest block over a comparatively narrow pelvis
structure.joint_integration: bulging, knobby joints with abrupt segment changes (shoulders, knees, ankles)
structure.segment_relations: short legs relative to trunk, long heavy arms, oversized hands and feet
structure.load_path: weight thrust forward from a massive upper trunk through flexed knees onto broad feet

non_structural_factors.notes: extreme muscularity contributes, but proportions, crouch and joint form are non-human-like

V11.drivers: Same body plan as V08: deep high ribcage bulging in profile, pinched waist, narrow pelvis, slender long limbs, long hands, knobby slightly flexed knees
limb_cues: long slender arms and long fingers
knee transition with slight flex/back bulge

structure.axial_section_shape: deep barrel chest tapering sharply to narrow waist and pelvis
structure.segment_relations: long arms/hands, slim long legs, small pelvis
structure.load_path: high chest mass over narrow pelvis to thin, slightly flexed legs

non_structural_factors.notes: slightly fuller than V08 but same organization

distinguishing_features: V08/V11 are slender with a deep keel-like chest over a pinched waist and narrow pelvis, long thin limbs and long hands, only slight knee flex. V10 is massive, with a huge shoulder/trapezius block, short thick bent legs, oversized hands and feet, and a forward-crouched load path. They differ in bulk, segment ratios and posture, so they separate easily without labels. V03/V07 vs the slim humans is a soft-tissue difference only and may not hold up.
